units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>נתן ס׳ שלו עליו</he> he put his seal on it (the prison door); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">ib.</cite> s. 49; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 34">Yalk. Gen. 34</cite> <cite ref="A01489"><he>איספרגוס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite>, beg. <he>שמו של הקב״ה חקוק … כמין איסטירטיגוס</he> (ed. Bub. <he>איסטרטיגוס</he>; corr. acc.) the name of the Lord is impressed upon the hearts of the angels like a seal.
